discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in ca7375293: `handleMove` now ends the drag (restoring listeners and body styles) when a move arrives with no button held, which covers a release outside the window that never delivers `pointerup`.

Fixed in bb45d79. The lookup now runs on every connected transport state (same pattern as use-agenda-tasks), so a failed or timed-out startup request recovers when the sidecar reconnects. The app URL depends only on the sidecar’s environment, not the signed-in account, so reconnect is the retry point rather than refreshAccount. Covered by a new test where the first lookup fails and the link appears after reconnecting.

Agreed, fixed in 34056fc61. When a later Hub startup fails, `Home` now replaces `App` with the startup screen instead of covering it (`showApp ? <App /> : <HubStartupScreen />`), so no app dialog can stay mounted to trap focus or turn off body pointer events. The screen also moved below dialogs (`z-40`), so `HubUpdateRequiredDialog` (`z-50`, still always mounted) stays on top. Unmounting doesn't lose anything extra: unsent drafts are already cleared when the sidecar reconnects, on `main` too.
